session.summary: Broke the App↔Views and App↔Views↔LocalPlayback cycles by turning the App project's root namespace into a pure shell (App, MainWindow, the app-level converter) and moving every service it used to hold into cohesive sub-namespaces: Hosting (AppServices, IAppHost, AppPage, navigation parameter records), Playback (PlaybackController, PlaybackState), Caching (VodCacheService, HlsAesDecryptMerger, VodDownloadManager), CacheCatalog (VodCacheLookup, LocalCachePlaybackCatalog), SourceHealth (VodSourceHealthProbe, VodPlayableSourceResolver), Updates (DesktopUpdateService), AiImport (AiCliLauncher, AiSourceWatcher). ImageLoader went to Controls, and the page-only helpers plus the page contracts INavigationAware/INavigationVisibilityAware went to Views. Core was split by concern into Core.Catalog, Core.VodSources, Core.StreamHealth and Core.Library, all depending one-way on Core (56 → 29 classes in Core). Tests for App-project classes moved to OrionTV.Desktop.Tests.App, changing only namespaces and usings (42 → 25 + 17 classes). Small moved types got new files in matching folders; large files only had their namespace declaration changed. The solution builds; tests were not run because no test runner was available. Smells 7–12 and 14 are only reduced or left unchanged, as explained per smell.

steps.text:
I've refactored the solution to remove the cycles, the unstable dependencies and the three God Components. The build succeeds, but there was no test runner available here, so the tests have not been run. Smells 7–12 and 14 are only reduced or left as they are; they are covered at the end and in each smell's rationale.

**What changed:**
- **App project root namespace:** it now holds only the shell (`App`, `MainWindow` and its nested `SectionNavigationState`) plus the app-level converter. Nothing else in the project depends on it, so both cycles are broken at the source.
- **Rest of the old root:** the rest of the old root namespace moved into new namespaces, each for one concern:
  - `Hosting`: shared services and navigation parameters (`AppServices`, `IAppHost`, `AppPage`).
  - `Playback`: the LibVLC player (`PlaybackController`, `PlaybackState`).
  - `Caching`: HLS download cache and download manager.
  - `CacheCatalog`: lookups over cached entries.
  - `SourceHealth`: VOD source probing.
  - `Updates`: the update service.
  - `AiImport`: AI CLI launcher and source watcher.
  - `ImageLoader` went to `Controls`. The page-only helpers (`LiveChannelViewModel`, `OsdController`, `PlayerKeyboardHook`) and the page contracts (`INavigationAware`, `INavigationVisibilityAware`) went to `Views`.
- **Core project:** split into `Core.Catalog`, `Core.VodSources`, `Core.StreamHealth` and `Core.Library`. All of them depend on `Core`, never the other way round. `SearchResultSources` and `AppleCmsVodItem` got their own files.
- **Tests project:** tests for App-project classes moved to `OrionTV.Desktop.Tests.App`. Only namespaces, `using`s and one fully qualified `AppServices` reference changed; no assertions were touched.

**Result per smell:**

| Smell | Status | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 1, 2 (cycles) | Removed | Nothing points back to the root; `LocalPlayback` now depends on `Playback`, not the root |
| 5, 6 (unstable dependency) | Removed | Every dependency now points to an equally or more stable namespace |
| 3, 4 (App root too big / mixed) | Removed | Root has 4 classes |
| 13 (Core too big) | Removed | 56 → 29 classes |
| 15 (Tests too big) | Removed | 25 and 17 classes |
| 7 (`Views` mixed) | Reduced | 9 unconnected groups → 2; LCC down from 0.53 to roughly 0.09 by my count |
| 8–12 (scattered functionality in `Views`) | Not removed | Each page combines several services by design; removing this would mean adding a facade or presenter layer, which is a separate redesign |
| 14 (Tests mixed) | Not removed | Test classes are independent of each other by nature |

**Things to check:**
- **New small namespaces:** if Designite also scores small namespaces, it may report new Feature Concentration findings. The likely ones are `AiImport` (two unconnected classes) and the remaining `Core` (several stand-alone helper classes).
- **Folders:** small moved files are now in folders that match their namespace. Large files (e.g. `VodCacheService.cs` at about 2,600 lines, `AppServices.cs`, `CatalogService.cs`) only had their namespace line changed, to avoid rewriting them by hand. A `git mv` would put them in matching folders.
- **Leftover XAML alias:** `DetailView.xaml` still declares an unused `app` alias pointing to the root namespace. It isn't a code dependency, so I left it.
